ja: 『装甲騎兵ボトムズ』特報！！
ソリッドシューター、ラウンドムーバーが、遂に1/20スケールでキット化！！
｢装甲騎兵ボトムズ｣ バンダイプラモデル 「1/20 スコープドッグ」（別売）に装着して、劇中シーンを再現しよう！
この商品は、バンダイプラモデル「1/20 スコープドッグ」（別売）に装着して楽しむ ‘武装’と‘オプションパーツ’です。
※ 本体等はこの商品に含まれません
● ソリッドシューターとラウンドムーバーを、新規造形のキットで再現。
（単色成形 ／ スナップフィット）
【ソリッドシューター、ラウンドムーバー】
新規造形の２種類の武装は、塗装してお楽しみいただく単色成形仕様です。
成形品による各武装類の素組み写真にて、ベースカラーをご確認ください。
（ 成形品写真は、６月中旬、当ページでご案内予定です！）
《 成形色 》　ソリッドシューター　･･･　深ミドリ
ラウンドムーバー　　･･･　ブルーグレー

● アクションベース対応 新規ジョイントパーツが付属！
空中シーンでのポーズディスプレイを可能にするアクションベース１に対応する、
新規造形の１／２０スコープドッグ専用ジョイントパーツ。

en: “Armored Trooper Votoms” special news! !
Solid shooter, round mover is finally available as a kit in 1/20 scale! !
Attach it to the "Armored Trooper Votoms" Bandai Plastic Model "1/20 Scopedog" (sold separately) and recreate the scenes from the movie!
This product is 'armed' and 'optional parts' that can be enjoyed by attaching it to Bandai Plastic Model "1/20 Scope Dog" (sold separately).
*The main unit etc. are not included in this product
● The solid shooter and round mover are reproduced with a newly designed kit.
(Single color molding/snap fit)
[Solid shooter, round mover]
The two types of newly modeled weapons are single-color molded specifications that can be painted and enjoyed.
Please check the base color in the unassembled photo of each weapon made from molded products.
(Photos of the molded product will be posted on this page in mid-June!)
《Molding color》 Solid Shooter... Deep Midori
Round mover... blue gray
* The molding color of the round mover is different from that included in the separately sold product "1/20 Scope Dog (Space Battle Specification)".
● Compatible with action base New joint parts included!
Compatible with Action Base 1, which enables pose display in aerial scenes.
Newly designed 1/20 scope dog joint parts.
* "Action Base 1" and "1/20 Scope Dog" are sold separately.
(Set contents)
・1/20 solid shooter × 1
・1/20 round mover x 1
・ Compatible with Action Base 1 (sold separately) 1/20 Scope Dog dedicated joint parts x 1
(Compatible products) *Sold separately *In addition to the following, compatible with products that use the same main kit.
"1/20 Scopedog" Now on sale at stores
"1/20 Scopedog (Pailsen Files version)" Now on sale at stores
"1/20 Scopedog (Melkia Army Color)" [Premium Bandai Sales Item] Applications for upcoming resale scheduled
★ Some products are scheduled for resale on September 9th. Resale information will be announced on the “Hobby Site” as soon as it is decided. Scheduled ★
1/20 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
